notes.title: Demo Version 0.7 Update & Recent Development Progress
notes.notes:
Complex Faction Relationships: I’ve managed to get this in, hoping it’ll work like Fallout: New Vegas (Everyone knows how hard it is to complete a game with such complex systems, but hey, what if it works? That’s how I comfort myself). 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711215/92d487f3a099a68b2db14bac052df468095a06bf.png

    UI Optimization — "Huge" Improvements: Dialogue and self-talk won’t get mixed up anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711215/739ec98c668236eae50b8584ecfa32309adab5c6.png

    Task System Overhaul: Now looks more like a standard quest log interface.

    Procedural & Time-limited Quests (in development): Yes, quests will be popping up like new items at the nearby fast-food joint—although probably just as uninspired.

    Faction Interactions: The game has several factions for you to befriend or stir up trouble with. Relationships are dynamic (sadly, no romantic relationships).

Key Changes:

    Tab: Open the quest log to see how many unfinished tasks you’ve taken on.

    Q: Bullet time, giving you a moment to react because, let’s face it, the world is not very friendly to you.

NineLives will participate in the MGN 2025 Indie Game Carnival, yes, the Steam online event! Also, there will be a live stream on ACFUN!

notes.title: 2025.1.31 - Demo 0.61 Small Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711215/cc2b863caae14750fed556f4e2d4652394593d74.jpg


 Battlefield Terrain Adjustment: Reduced the phenomenon of characters being launched by terrain collisions.
 Sound Feedback Optimization: Gunshots will now decrease in volume over longer distances, enhancing immersion.
 Enemy Health Adjustment: Some enemies’ health has been slightly lowered to improve game fluidity.
 Tutorial Tips Enhancement: Adjusted certain prompts to help new players better understand the game mechanics.
 Bounty System Added: In the first level, killing an agent will trigger a police response. Don’t try to stop them!
 Vlad Character Adjustment: Slightly increased Vlad’s jump height and air control, improving his mobility.

notes.title: NineLives Demo Update 2025.1.17
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711215/1e0b62c51ce98dde0dac40e1d4f82e4c37ad95e2.jpg
    Item System:

    Added new items (for crafting, dismantling, random drops such as trash, materials, luxury goods, food, etc.) which will appear as loot and random drops in the underground clinic level.
    Updated the icon for bullets.

    Inventory System:

    Inventory size increased from 12 slots to 20. Equip the takeaway bag to gain an additional 14 slots (this was done early, but you couldn’t see it in the demo; also requires cybernetic surgery, which can be unlocked via dialogue with the doctor).
    Quick-use item bar, dedicated to recovery items like food and medicine, expanded from 1 slot to 4 slots. You can now quickly use items by pressing the corresponding number keys (1, 2, 3, 4).
    Widened the item description UI to better fit languages with longer text like German and Russian.

    Weapon System:

    Removed the crosshair icon for firearms (it didn’t really serve much of a purpose 🫠).
    Adjusted recoil for certain firearms (re-tested and it felt like the gunplay was shaking too much 🫨).

    Miscellaneous:

    Slightly adjusted the NPC's movement range by 5 cm.
    Fixed the black screen issue after death (though I’m still unsure why there’s a small chance it could trigger 😅—likely related to the save/load system. I’ll keep monitoring and address it).
